svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Web application on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Web application on Google Cloud. 8 components in 4 groups. Connections: Users to Cloud Load Balancing (HTTPS); Cloud Armor to Cloud Load Balancing; Cloud CDN to Cloud Load Balancing; Cloud Load Balancing to Cloud Run (serverless NEG); Cloud Run to Cloud SQL; Cloud Run to Secret Manager; Cloud Run to Memorystore (Direct VPC egress).

text.tspan: A global load balancer in front of Cloud Run, with Cloud CDN and Cloud Armor on its backend, backed by Cloud SQL and Memorystore
Static asset cache on the LB
Attached to the load balancer backend
